------
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----
For the Petitioner: M/s. Diwakar Jha, Advocate For the State : M/s. S. K. Tiwari, A.P.P
---
03/09.01.2025 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with Domchanch P.S. Case no. 48/2024 registered under Sections 341/323/376(2)(n)/504/506/34 of Indian Penal Code, Section 4/6 POCSO Act and Sections 66 (D) / 66(E) of I.T. Act, 2000, pending in the court of Learned District &
Additional Sessions Judge-I, Koderma.
The petitioner is said to have established physical relationship with the victim who is a minor girl aged about 15 years.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case and considering the nature of allegation;
I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Saurabh uploaded Neeraj vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
